name: LiveChatAI
author: popupsmart

sections.description:
LiveChatAI is the easiest way to add intelligent customer support to your WordPress website. Our AI-powered chatbot resolves 70% of customer queries automatically, saving time for both your team and your customers.

🚀 Why Choose LiveChatAI?

  • 5-Minute Setup – Just paste your chatbot ID and you’re live
  • 70% Resolution Rate – Proven to handle most customer queries automatically
  • 24/7 AI Support – Your customers get instant help any time
  • Seamless Human Handoff – Complex issues transfer to your team automatically
  • Multiple Integration Options – Auto-load, shortcodes, widgets, or Gutenberg blocks
  • Modern Professional UI – Beautiful interface that matches your brand

⚡ Key Features

  • Instant AI Responses – Get answers from your knowledge base immediately
  • Multi-Language Support – Communicate with customers in 95+ languages
  • Mobile Optimized – Perfect experience on all devices and screen sizes
  • WordPress Native – Built specifically for WordPress with no conflicts
  • Advanced Analytics – Track performance and customer satisfaction
  • GDPR Compliant – Privacy-focused design with data protection built-in

🎯 Perfect For

  • E-commerce Stores – Handle product questions, orders, and support
  • Service Businesses – Qualify leads and answer common questions
  • SaaS Companies – Reduce support tickets with instant answers
  • Content Creators – Engage with your audience 24/7
  • Any WordPress Site – Improve user experience with instant help

🛠️ How It Works

  1. Create Your Chatbot – Sign up at LiveChatAI.com and create your AI assistant
  2. Train with Your Data – Upload documents, add Q&As, or connect your website
  3. Get Your Chatbot ID – Copy the ID from your dashboard’s “Embed & Integrate” section
  4. Install & Configure – Paste your ID in WordPress settings and you’re live!

📋 Integration Options

Automatic Messenger (Recommended)
The chatbot appears as a floating messenger on all pages automatically.

Shortcode Integration
[livechatai]
[livechatai chatbot_id="your-custom-id"]

WordPress Widget
Add to sidebars, footers, or any widget area through Appearance → Widgets.

Gutenberg Block
Search for “LiveChatAI” in the block editor for visual integration.

🎨 Customization

  • Custom Styling – Match your brand colors and design
  • Custom Messages – Personalize greetings and responses
  • Advanced Routing – Route conversations based on intent
  • Integration Ready – Connect with CRM, email, and other tools

🔧 Developer Friendly

  • Clean Code – Well-documented and following WordPress standards
  • Hooks & Filters – Customize behavior with WordPress actions and filters
  • No Conflicts – Designed to work seamlessly with other plugins
  • Performance Optimized – Lightweight and fast-loading

📞 Need Help?

  • Documentation – help.livechatai.com
  • Video Tutorials – Step-by-step setup guides
  • Live Support – Chat with our team (yes, we use our own chatbot!)
  • Community Forum – Connect with other users

Additional Info

Minimum Requirements:
* WordPress 5.0 or higher
* PHP 7.4 or higher
* A LiveChatAI account (free signup available)

Recommended:
* WordPress latest version
* PHP 8.0 or higher
* HTTPS enabled (for optimal security)

Links:
* Plugin Homepage
* LiveChatAI Dashboard
* Documentation
* Support
* Privacy Policy

Made with ❤️ by the LiveChatAI Team
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “LiveChatAI”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Go to Settings → LiveChatAI to configure

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the zip file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to Settings → LiveChatAI to configure

Getting Your Chatbot ID

  1. Sign up at LiveChatAI.com
  2. Create and train your chatbot
  3. Go to Embed & Integrate → Add as Messenger
  4. Copy the data-id value from the script
  5. Paste it in WordPress → Settings → LiveChatAI
sections.faq:
Do I need a LiveChatAI account?

Yes, you need a free account at LiveChatAI.com to create and manage your chatbot. The plugin connects your WordPress site to your LiveChatAI chatbot.

Is there a free plan?

Yes! LiveChatAI offers a free plan that includes basic chatbot functionality. Paid plans unlock advanced features like unlimited messages, integrations, and priority support.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The LiveChatAI script loads asynchronously and won’t affect your page load times. It’s optimized for performance and loads only when needed.

Can I customize the chatbot appearance?

Yes! You can customize colors, position, messages, and behavior through your LiveChatAI dashboard. The chatbot will automatically match your brand.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes, LiveChatAI is designed to work with any WordPress theme. The messenger widget is positioned as a floating element that won’t interfere with your site’s design.

Can I use multiple chatbots?

Yes, you can use different chatbot IDs for different pages using shortcodes or widgets, while having a default chatbot for the entire site.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! The chatbot messenger is fully responsive and provides an excellent experience on all devices and screen sizes.

How do I remove the plugin?

Simply deactivate and delete the plugin from Plugins → Installed Plugins. All plugin data will be removed automatically.

Where can I get support?

Visit our help center, check the documentation, or contact our support team through the LiveChatAI dashboard.
